subject: Security intake workshop: CAIQ/SOC2 Q&A and artifacts — scheduling
messages:
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@cygnus-analytics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security workshop and Q&A for onboarding

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Cygnus is kicking off an evaluation and we need to run a short workshop to align on the CAIQ and SOC 2 evidence we can expect. Our procurement and security teams want a single 60–75 minute session to:
- review the CAIQ questionnaire we filled out
- confirm log / retention samples you can provide (anonymized)
- agree on a handoff timeline for artifact transfer and any follow-ups

Attendees on our side: me (security), Paul Kim (procurement). Can you propose two slots next week? Also we attached a one-page scope summary for context (see attachment).

Thanks,
Lena Morris
Head of Security Operations
Cygnus Analytics
Attachment: cygnus_scope_summary.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Lena Morris <lena.morris@cygnus-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security workshop and Q&A for onboarding

Hi Lena — great to hear from you and thanks for the scope summary.

We can run a focused 60-minute workshop that covers CAIQ walkthrough, what artifacts we can share (logging samples, config screenshots, key management notes), and a short Q&A. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tuesday 2026-10-06 10:00–11:00
- Wednesday 2026-10-07 14:00–15:00

Draft run-of-show I suggest:
1) 5 min intros + goals (you, Paul, me)
2) 20 min CAIQ question highlights: where we tend to see gaps
3) 15 min artifacts we can provide + how they are sanitized
4) 15 min Q&A specific to your compliance scope and redlines
5) 5 min action items + next steps (artifact handoff owner + timeline)

I've attached a short agenda and the CAIQ question bank we usually run through — we can tailor which sections you want to prioritize. Can you confirm preferred slot and any add'l attendees?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_workshop_agenda.pdf; caiq_question_bank.xlsx

Lena / Marissa — I can take the artifacts portion. Quick ask from procurement: when you say 'log samples' can you confirm format and whether they need any additional scrubbing beyond IP/user redaction? We commonly provide: sample stdout logs, anonymized access logs (CSV), and a short writeup on retention policy.

If you prefer, I can share a short checklist of the exact files we can hand over during the session.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@cygnus-analytics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Paul Kim <paul.kim@cygnus-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security workshop and Q&A for onboarding

Thanks — Wednesday 2026-10-07 14:00 PT works best for us. Attendees: me (Lena), Paul Kim (procurement), and our cloud engineer Aaron Singh (aaron.singh@cygnus-analytics.com).

For log samples, anonymized CSV is ideal. Please include a short README describing what each column represents and approximate time windows. No additional scrubbing beyond removing IPs and replacing user IDs with pseudonyms is required.

I've attached our initial CAIQ entries (spreadsheet) and the scope summary again for reference. Also, Paul asked if you can outline the expected handoff timeline during the meeting (we're aiming for artifact delivery within two weeks post-workshop if feasible).

Thanks — see you Wednesday.
Lena

Confirmed for Wednesday 2026-10-07 14:00–15:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. Quick run-of-show and decisions we captured so everyone is aligned before the call:

Run-of-show (final):
- 14:00–14:05 Introductions & goals (Marissa / Lena)
- 14:05–14:25 CAIQ focus areas (Marissa) — we will call out items with likely follow-ups
- 14:25–14:40 Artifact preview (Ben) — show sample log formats and README
- 14:40–14:55 Q&A + procurement clarifications (Paul / Jordan)
- 14:55–15:00 Action items & timeline (Marissa)

Decisions / action owners captured here:
- Redwood to provide anonymized log samples (CSV) + README — owner: Ben — deliver within 10 business days after workshop
- Redwood to mark CAIQ sections that may need follow-up evidence — owner: Marissa — initial annotations in 3 business days
- Cygnus to confirm any additional attendees or specific CAIQ rows to prioritize — owner: Lena — by EOD Monday 2026-10-05

Attachments we will drop into the post-call folder: cygnus_scope_summary.pdf, cygnus_caiq_questions.xlsx, redwood_workshop_agenda.pdf

If that matches your expectations, no action needed until the call. Otherwise reply here with changes.

Best,
